notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register has one entry for Sedalia giving county, agency (only 'National Forest') and 'Removed'. Two searches and three page reads found no build date, design, staffing or fire history. The Sedalia Campground is on the Enoree Ranger District of Sumter National Forest; no source ties it to the tower site, so the story does not treat the two as one place. The agency value 'National Forest' is the register's wording and is not a specific unit. Next step if time: Sumter National Forest history or Union County newspaper archives for the tower's build and removal.
